title: Geometry-Dependent Approximation for Non-Monotone $k$-Submodular Maximization
summary: We study nonnegative, non-monotone $k$-submodular maximization with $k\ge2$ labels under support constraints, and show how the certified approximation coefficient improves as the support region permits more uniform selection. For a compact convex down-closed support region $P\subseteq[0,1]^n$, the diagonal level $ζ(P)=\max\{t\in[0,1]:t {\bf 1} \in P\}$ ranges from $ζ=0$, which carries no geometric promise, to $ζ=1$, which is unrestricted support.
